svg.aria-label: Scores come from Git, not from the app UI: 1. Config: The recyclarr.yml ConfigMap lists which TRaSH profiles and custom formats each *arr app receives. 2. Fetch: Recyclarr reads the TRaSH Guides data and matches every profile and format by its trash_id. 3. Score: It creates or updates the profiles and scores in Radarr and Sonarr, and deletes custom formats the file no longer declares. 4. Assign: It never moves a movie or a series to another profile. Which profile a title uses is app state in Radarr and Sonarr.
